chapter_seo_title: Bai Qi, Golden Halberd, and the Most Evil Place in the Soul World
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen explores the Soul World, reunites with the war god Bai Qi, and uncovers the secret of two weapons evolving toward Ancestral God power in the legendary most evil place.

og_description: Xiao Chen and Bai Qi form an alliance to capture the Golden Divine Halberd and Dark-Iron Seal, which have been secretly evolving in the Soul World's most sinister location.
